independent_unit: OpenML dataset after averaging three folds
comparison_family: top-five methods in published Table 1 order
limitations: The pinned author snapshot does not exactly reproduce the published Table 1 and therefore cannot validate the paper-time inferential claims.
The percentile bootstrap interval is approximate and is reported with a fixed seed and resample count.
Dataset independence is a declared study-design assumption; the script can reject known clustering but cannot discover hidden dependence absent metadata.
